phase3_findings.description: The cadence-rule sentence 'advance this baseline whenever a change alters the granted helper-head set of any profile in lib/capability-profiles.json' could be read as mandating an immediate bump on every grant edit; suggest clarifying the release-snapshot nature.

fix_decisions.claim_text: cadence-rule sentence could read as per-grant-edit obligation
fix_decisions.evidence: AC5 mandates this exact operational trigger (grant-set change advances the baseline); the suggested reword ('when it should track a newly-released set') would make the rule discretionary and weaken AC5. The registration-deferral the reviewer worries about is already explained in the sentence immediately following the cadence rule ('A newly-granted head becomes a REQUIRED_HELPER_HEADS member only once the baseline advances past the release that first shipped it').

parking_evidence.basis: the ambiguity is resolved by the adjacent sentence, and rewording would weaken the AC5-mandated operational rule
parking_evidence.failing_input: a maintainer reading only the cadence sentence in isolation
parking_evidence.source: lib/test/cloud_writer_contract.py:94-102 (the full cadence comment including the decoupling sentence)
